newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Hermis active as Lithuanian shares dip.
newsitem.headline: Hermis active as Lithuanian shares dip.

text.p: Shares on the Lithuanian stock exchange dipped in moderate trade on Tuesday, with one of the country's leading banks, Hermis Bank, showing healthy activity, dealers said.
Central market volume was 824,000 litas and the group A index, which tracks the most active listings, dipped 51.15 points to 1,373.
Shares in Hermis Bank, were the most active, rising to 143 litas from 142 litas on trade of 286,000 litas.
Dealers said that foreign investors have been behind the recent action in Hermis, which has led market activity recently.
The Birzhu Dairy, which is planning to launch an international issue of its shares, traded almost 100,000 litas and it rose to 5.50 litas from 5.20 litas.
Bloc trades on Tuesday came to 1.26 million litas while the secondary T-bill market turned over 35,400 litas.
